bio.headline: About
bio.story: I’m Juan Sebastian Acosta Pinilla, a web developer based in Montréal, QC, currently completing Vanier College’s Web Design Specialist program. I’m seeking a winter internship where I can learn quickly, contribute to real projects, and grow within a supportive team.

working_style.headline: How I Work
working_style.story: I’m reliable, focused, and comfortable working in small teams. I value clear communication, shared goals, and steady progress. I take ownership of my work and enjoy collaborating with others to solve problems and deliver quality results.

current_focus.headline: What I’m Working On
current_focus.story: I’m currently building portfolio projects that combine clean interfaces with solid backend functionality. I enjoy working on features where structure, data, and logic are just as important as presentation.

key_projects.headline: Projects
key_projects.story: The projects shown here reflect my ability to learn quickly, follow requirements, and build complete features from start to finish. They are representative of the kind of work I’m ready to support as an intern.

core_skills.headline: Skills Overview
core_skills.story: I work primarily with modern web technologies and have a strong foundation in both frontend and backend development. I’m especially interested in backend-leaning roles, while remaining open to full-stack learning opportunities.

development_process.headline: How I Approach Projects
development_process.story: I start by understanding the problem, then break work into manageable steps. I focus on writing clear, maintainable code and improving through feedback and iteration. I’m comfortable adapting to new tools and workflows as needed.

motivations.headline: What Drives Me
motivations.story: I enjoy learning through building and improving systems over time. I’m motivated by progress, collaboration, and the satisfaction of delivering something that works well and is easy for others to use or maintain.

career_goals.headline: What I’m Looking For
career_goals.story: I’m looking for a winter internship starting between February and April in an environment that values learning, mentorship, and teamwork. I’m especially drawn to small teams and growing companies where I can contribute meaningfully while continuing to develop my skills.
